On 11 August 2023, the Government of Burkina Faso received peer support for accreditation of a National Implementing Entity to the Adaptation Fund from the Centre de Suivi Ecologique (CSE) of Senegal. The support included the following components:

  1. Developing and updating policies manuals (project cycle management guide, monitoring and evaluation guide, grievance management manual, procurement manual, anti-fraud and AML/ CFT policies. 
  2. Workshops, Meetings and technical assistance .
